evidence: Has 'Build system' label and directly modifies Guix build scripts, glibc package definitions, and release validation checks in contrib/guix/.
rationale: Compiling non-GUI Linux release binaries with `-static-pie` solves broad compatibility issues across distributions without glibc (e.g. Alpine) or running older glibc versions. As noted in the release notes, this enables binaries to run portably on non-glibc systems and older distributions without compatibility loaders or custom shims, delivering substantial, durable value to release distribution.
